items.title: Service-account names in decision chips wrap mid-name onto three lines ('svc- / mailer- / 1')
items.fix: Add .chip-name { white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0 } and .chip-badge { min-width: 0 }. Or scope .direction-question .chip-select { flex-wrap: wrap } and give the badge its own line. The Picker CSS is shared, so check the other step pickers.
items.bucket_reason: Names wrap but stay legible, and the shared picker CSS reaches finished steps.

items.title: Without P1, Readiness still points into a plan that isn't there, and loses its only how-to link
items.fix: When planSteps lacks s-prereq-passkey-settings, show an admin-center path line instead (new key). Without P1, hide G.suggestion and footer.plan. Give the method group a How or admin-center link when no plan step exists.
items.bucket_reason: A no-P1 tenant state; revisit with the no-P1 page decision.

items.title: After 'Show the next 50', keyboard focus stays on a button now 3,000 px off-screen, and the next Tab skips the 50 new rows
items.fix: After a load, focus the first new row's Details button (a ref keyed by the row index) and announce 'Showing {shown} of {n}' in a visually hidden role=status.
items.bucket_reason: Paging past 50 people only happens in large tenants.

items.title: In the demo, 'Scan to update the plan' quietly switches to a pretend follow-up scan that completes work, and decisions, the user never did
items.fix: When scan() switches the demo, set a session flag and show one demo-only line in the banner from a new shell key: 'In the sample, Scan shows a follow-up scan: the work and answers in it are the sample's, not yours.' Clear it when Initial scan is chosen. Add a unit test.
items.bucket_reason: In the demo, Scan silently completes work and decisions the evaluator never made; one banner line keeps the behaviour and removes the confusion.

items.title: Four places give four answers to 'are both emergency accounts outside the enforced MFA policy?', and 'Configure Emergency Exclusions' says 5 policies in one place and 4 in another
items.fix: Add excludeGroups: [] to the demo day-one MFA row (Graph always returns the array). The exclusions step then lists and counts 5, and the MFA step's add becomes that step's edit. Reword cleanup 'why' so it does not say the group is already in place. Re-run the demo and exclusionsStep tests and the step snapshots.
items.bucket_reason: Four screens give four answers on whether the emergency accounts sit outside the enforced MFA policy, the one question lockout safety rests on.

items.title: A deferral's required reason is never shown again (not on the step, the plan or the print), and deferring shrinks the progress total
items.fix: Show 'Deferred {date}: {reason}' on the deferred card from milestone.gatedBy and the skipped history date. Add the reason to BriefLine for aside rows and print it in 'Not in this plan'. Optionally add a sub-line to the Completed tile ('1 deferred'). Test the print and the card.
items.bucket_reason: A deferral's required reason is never shown again, and deferring shrinks the progress total the manager reads.

items.title: The Plan says 10 of 30 people are not ready; the linked MFA Readiness page, its CSV and the print say 21, 25 or 26, and no count names its bar
items.fix: When the page is opened from s-verify-mfa and the step is not complete, scope to preparation.missingIds instead of preparation.ids. Add a new planContext.notReady key: 'Filtered to the {cohort} {step} names as not ready.' The headline then reads 'x of 10'. When scoped, show footer.plan under the headline. The step screen and its link stay unchanged.
items.bucket_reason: The Plan says 10 people are not ready while Readiness, its CSV and the briefing say 21, 25 or 26 with no bar named.

items.title: The demo, Connect and How never say how to remove the tenant data kept in this browser
items.fix: Add one sentence to the Connect removal line and to How > Where it runs: 'What IAMAI keeps in this browser stays after Sign out; Account → Forget this tenant deletes it.' These are content-only edits to existing keys. Update any publicTrust/connectSignedOut assertion that pins the old text.
items.bucket_reason: Nothing says Sign out leaves tenant data in the browser, a disclosure risk on shared PCs that one sentence fixes.

items.title: Switching from a scrolled Plan to MFA Readiness keeps the old scroll offset, and Readiness has no sticky header, so the page opens mid-list with no heading or navigation
items.fix: In useHashRoute's onChange, when the resolved route differs from the previous one and the hash is not a deep link (#/plan/<id>, #/how#package), call window.scrollTo(0,0). Same-route hash changes (Readiness filters, step open/close) keep their position. Put the route-change logic in a pure helper and unit-test it.
items.bucket_reason: Switching surfaces keeps the old scroll offset, so Readiness opens mid-list with no heading or navigation.

items.title: Completion criteria and the AI briefing contain contradictions and stray text: 'except Core - Exclusions and Break-glass 1', 'for guests except Core - Exclusions and guests', and a stray 'strong:' line
items.fix: In aiGrounding, skip role-keyed lines on a single-member step, or use the member's title in place of the key. In policyFact, name the excluded guest types by their portal names ('service provider users') instead of w.guests. Test both on the demo guests step with the partner answer Yes.
items.bucket_reason: Done-when text keeps a by-name emergency exclusion and appears to exempt guests from the guest MFA policy.

items.title: The scan wait shows only the current section and elapsed seconds; the read-only line disappears, nothing says whether you can leave, and Stop or a reload silently discards the scan
items.fix: Keep ready.note in the scanning state and add a new key: keep this tab open, you can read How meanwhile. Show '{done} of {total} sections' from TOTAL_SECTIONS. Put role=status on the state line. Add a beforeunload handler while runner.state is 'running'. A Stop confirmation is optional.
items.bucket_reason: Scan-wait guidance matters only if real scans run long; check real scan durations first.

items.title: Without P1, the calendar, prompts and bundle still export a 'Conditional Access rollout' that the screen says doesn't exist, including work that needs P1
items.fix: In Export.tsx compute noPlanLine(snapshot). When it is set, replace the calendar and prompts cards' buttons with that sentence (pages.plan.conditionalAccessNeedsP1), and make bundle.plan = { none: line } with no steps or cleanup. Keep the CSVs and the plan file.
items.bucket_reason: No-P1 exports; revisit with the no-P1 page decision (F-173).

items.title: Without P1, Conditional Access policies that still exist and still enforce MFA are ignored
items.fix: Export mirrors Plan and print: if conditionalAccessLicenceLine(snapshot) is set, render that Callout and offer no plan files, only the inventory CSVs. Alternatively, generate.ts skips cleanupPhaseFor when !canUseConditionalAccess (engine; same outcome everywhere). Listing the lapsed policies on the refusal page needs owner input.
items.bucket_reason: Lapsed-P1 tenants with leftover policies are real but unseen so far, and listing them needs owner input.

items.title: A tenant with no policies and security defaults off is never told nobody is asked for MFA today, and the print counts an empty exclusions step as 'in place'
items.fix: When caPolicies is read in full with 0 enabled policies and securityDefaults is off, show one line above the tiles and in the briefing's intro from a new content key: 'Nobody is asked for MFA today: no Conditional Access policies are on and security defaults are off.' Use sectionHasData guards and a unit test on the policies=0 mock snapshot.
items.bucket_reason: A tenant with no policies and security defaults off, a common starting point, is never told nobody is asked for MFA, and the briefing calls an empty exclusions step done.

items.title: 'Up Next' steps give go-live and exclusion-removal instructions, plus a script that writes to the tenant, and never say 'not yet'
items.fix: In policyProcedureOf, when a corrected member has exclusionsEdit=true and the exclusions step is still open, start the 'correct' task with one line from a new key, e.g. 'Do this after {step} adds {group} to this policy.' Reword changeRemoves as the swap ('replaces {removed} with {group}') when the body adds the group. Test on demo legacy-auth, device-code and admins.
items.bucket_reason: Up Next policy steps offer 'Turn the policy on' with no 'not yet' while emergency-access prerequisites are unfinished, a lockout path for P1.

items.title: Report-only evidence is one unquantified sentence, so 'nothing was evaluated' reads the same as 'safe to enforce'
items.fix: Add readyBasis(ready) to the blockedNoOne card line (e.g. 'Report-only blocked no one: 0 failures in {n} days, {seen} of {people} seen'). Where there is no ready reading, give the date the window started. Test on demo-week2 Token Protection.
items.bucket_reason: 'Report-only blocked no one' reads the same whether nothing was evaluated or everything passed, so unknown reads as safe to enforce.

items.title: No export says when a policy is turned on: the calendar holds 7–8 eight-day blocks for Ready preparation steps only, and the print has no per-step dates
items.fix: Ask the owner first whether the calendar follows the 2026-09-23 reversal. If yes: in buildIcs, book a held row as a one-day event on the board's estimate (board.readings.get(id).estimate, carried on the export view) titled '… · Est. <date>', instead of skipping it at ics.ts:118. If no: narrow cards.calendar to 'Steps with a day of their own'. Either way, render whatToDo as numbered lines and turn [text](url) into 'text (url)'.
items.bucket_reason: Whether the calendar dates held turn-ons follows the owner's undated-held-steps decision; ask first, then date them or narrow the card's claim.

items.title: One click on 'Everyone works remotely' inside Define the Trusted Network answers a decision, removes 5 steps and makes the open step vanish, with no confirmation or undo
items.fix: Make the button two presses: the first shows chosen.remote plus Confirm and Cancel, and only Confirm calls onAnswer. After a change that removes the open step, move focus and scroll to the Updated status. Add a unit test.
items.bucket_reason: The one-click answer is deliberate; revisit a confirm, since it removes five steps and marks a decision approved.

items.title: Inventory shows two accounts using legacy authentication; the Block Legacy Authentication step names only one
items.fix: Keep one source. Point Inventory and serviceAccounts.ts at legacySignInIds(), and drop evidenceUsage.legacyAuth as the legacy reading. Make the demo's legacy data come from its own sign-in rows so Inventory, Identify Service Accounts and Block Legacy Authentication name the same accounts. Test: the demo Inventory legacy list equals the block step's names.
items.bucket_reason: The legacy-auth block names one account while Inventory shows two, so the second mailbox stops with nobody warned.

items.title: The same person is given different next steps on MFA Readiness, Prepare Your Team for MFA and Require MFA to Register a Device
items.fix: In a step-scoped view where stepRegistersDevice(step), draw each row's next step from readinessNextOf(snapshot, now, mapping, true), the card's own words. Reword s-verify-mfa instruction 9 to '…set up the method named beside them'; this is approved step content, so it needs the owner's yes. The Readiness-only part can ship alone.
items.bucket_reason: The same person gets different next steps on three screens.

items.title: Completing a step leaves no 'what next', and the confirmation appears off-screen
items.fix: When the open step's lane turns Completed, show the change line inside the step's rail. Add 'Next: <first Ready step on the board> →' (a new content key) linking #/plan/<id>. Keep the procedure. Also drop the empty 'For each account:' list on Dormant once every account is kept.
items.bucket_reason: OWN-W1's Next line covers what comes next; a per-step Next link can wait.

items.title: Passkey model decision needs raw AAGUIDs typed in; the affected model cannot be approved from its card
items.fix: At emergencyJourney.ts:302, always add the lockedOut accounts to the card items so card and task name the same accounts. In PasskeyModelDecision, check duplicates against passkeyApprovedModelsOf(mapping) as well. Optionally add 'Approve this model' on each affected item to prefill name and AAGUID.
items.bucket_reason: The card-versus-task account mismatch is F-036; approving a model from its card is a later feature.

items.title: 4.3 leads with weakening a stricter admin policy
items.fix: Where every open difference is stricter (no weaker or required piece), open the Correct card with one line: 'Yours is stricter than the baseline in {n} ways: keep it by accepting the difference with a reason, or match the baseline below.' The exact-controls rule is unchanged.
items.bucket_reason: Leading a stricter admin policy with weakening instructions goes away under build-new; revisit with that decision.

items.title: Require MFA for Everyone blocks on 53 raw group IDs, says 'scan again', and then turns Completed after the next scan while the panel still says Blocked
items.fix: XS part: word the reason as '{n} groups this policy names could not be read' with at most 5 display names and 'and N more' (namesOf). Engine part: after a live check at ?dev=1&mock=1&big=1, make sure a step still carrying an unverified-exclusion blocker is never counted as satisfied.
items.bucket_reason: Completed-while-Blocked appeared only with 53 unreadable mock groups; reproduce with a real deleted excluded group before engine work, and promote it if it reproduces.

items.title: Weeks later the plan silently re-dates every unfinished step to today: nothing reads overdue, the finish slides, and the (i) blames report-only for the slip
items.fix: Split it. XS: add SEQUENCE:<minutes since epoch> to each VEVENT, and mark a freeze whose 'to' < today as past. S: when planWeeks > the forecast span, the tip says 'N weeks since the plan started on {start}; the remaining work finishes {date} because …' (new engine.critical key). L: persist the first-planned finish and show 'finish moved from {date}', which needs owner approval since it's data that persists.
items.bucket_reason: Weeks later the finish tip blames report-only for a slip it did not cause; fix the tip's reason now and leave slip tracking for later.

items.title: Policy JSON and PowerShell exist on only 8 of 19 policy steps, not on the two core MFA policies, and vanish when a step is deferred, though Export says they are on each step
items.fix: Reword Export implementationNote to 'Where a step hands over a change it can make now, its JSON and PowerShell are on that step in the Plan.' Optional (S, frozen): one line on a policy step with no PS/JSON naming what holds them.
items.bucket_reason: The untrue Export sentence is OWN-X1; target-policy JSON on every step is a feature.

items.title: Group headers and tab badges don't follow the active filters
items.fix: (a) When focusActive, draw All work headers with the filtered count ('1 of 4 steps', groupSummary with total) instead of progress. (b) Pass total=null for secondary (aside) groups. Optional: badges count the focus-filtered set when a focus is on. Tests in planBoard.test.ts for both headers.
items.bucket_reason: The header count is true for the group; only filtered views look short, and the filter is visibly on.

items.title: Work type categories leave policy work out of 'Conditional Access', and the select has no label
items.fix: Add s-create-report-only and s-prereq-exclusion-group (and the cleanup consolidation and naming rows, if they should count) to WORK_TYPE_IDS as 'ca'. Rename BOARD.type.resolution to something like 'Accounts & decisions' after an owner yes. Test: workTypeOf for those ids.
items.bucket_reason: The 'Conditional Access' work type leaves out the step that creates six policies, so the filter hides the main CA work.

items.title: Redaction differs by export, and the bundle's switch gives no sign of which version will download
items.fix: Add an identifiers sentence to pages.export.cards.print[1]. Render the warning Callout only when !bundleRedacted. Read the warning from pages.export.unredactedWarning and delete the comms.ts copy. Use 'sign-in addresses' in both places.
items.bucket_reason: The unredacted warning shows whether or not redaction is ticked, and the print card never says it carries addresses and the tenant id.

items.title: Before sign-in the planner shows no navigation, and How is a dead end from the home page
items.fix: When no account is signed in, end How with the two Connect actions, reusing the keys at content.json:757 ('Try it with sample data' → demoUrl(), 'Sign in with Microsoft' → #/connect). App.tsx:380 passes account to How. Leave the header as it is.
items.bucket_reason: Back returns to Home; add the two Connect actions to How if evaluators report getting stuck.

items.title: The demo path never shows the 'Public beta — check every script' caveat or the '1 section was not read in full' notice; both live only on Connect
items.fix: In AppShell, drive the partialEvidence line from unreadSources(snapshot).length > 0, the same source Connect uses, rather than a second check on config status==='error'. Consider rewording partialEvidence to name the section and the next step (the owner rule: say what is known), e.g. 'Registered methods were read in part; readiness counts are conservative. Scan again to complete them.' Test: the demo snapshot shows the line on Plan. No beta banner.
items.bucket_reason: Only the partial-read half: the Plan never says it was built on a partial read. The beta-caveat half is dropped: the banner was removed on purpose (cdf79d82).

items.title: 'Everyone works remotely' silently undoes the service-accounts decision: service accounts and the Teams Room fall under MFA for Everyone
items.fix: Add keys steps.accounts.whyRemote and serviceAccounts.joinsRemote. Choose them when savedAnswerOf('officeNetwork') is 'remote', the way direction.ts:189 already does for shared devices.
items.bucket_reason: 'Everyone works remotely' silently puts service accounts and the Teams Room under MFA for Everyone while their completed decision says otherwise.

items.title: An open step can be closed only from its row header: no Close control in the panel, and Esc does nothing
items.fix: Add an onKeyDown on the open step article. On Escape, when not inside a dialog, input or open picker, close the step the way the row header does and focus the row button.
items.bucket_reason: Opening another row closes the step and the admin scrolls back to the list anyway; Esc-to-close is a nicety.

items.title: Prepare Your Team says the registration campaign is already on, then tells you to turn it on
items.fix: Have campaignToday name what differs when the campaign is on, e.g. 'on, with no method or users set' (new campaign keys). Alternatively reword line 13 as 'Change it to:'.
items.bucket_reason: Prepare Your Team says the registration campaign is already on, then tells the admin to turn it on.

items.title: The admin MFA step has no Readiness hand-off, and its Readiness view gives a misleading reason
items.fix: Reword seamlessNotPossible so it names no cause, e.g. 'Nobody can be seamless yet: each person's row says what stops their devices.' Optionally let the admin gate card carry the readinessLink too, by widening the condition at stepContract.ts:2662 for the admin family.
items.bucket_reason: The admin Readiness view gives a 'personal computer' reason that is not true; reword it to name no cause.

items.title: The exclusions group the plan calls 'Verified' is missing from Inventory's 'Everything the scan read' and from the Groups CSV

items.title: After a Follow-up scan the numbers change with no explanation of who moved, including a silent regression

items.title: The cleanup steps look like a different product, and the overlap review form is unstyled and opaque
items.fix: Move the form words to content.json. Stack each label above its control using the shared decision-field classes, and make inputs full width. Pass listAll to the Picker. items.title: The Readiness Details drawer lets focus leave while it stays open, covers focusable controls at 1024–1280, and hides device join state from keyboard users

items.title: When Conditional Access policies can't be read, the plan still says 'Ready', tells you to create policies and a trusted location that already exist, and nothing on Plan, Export or the printed plan says so
items.fix: Mock: when denied=1, route through coreGaps as state=gaps does (XS, dev only). Real residue: Export names the CSVs it doesn't offer, in known-fact words and without 'couldn't read'. Replace ContentStep.tsx:1214's hard-coded line with a content key saying the next step: 'Scan again with Security Reader to include your office networks'.

items.title: Most state changes are silent to assistive technology
items.fix:
Mount one always-present visually-hidden

on Plan and write short messages into it: 'Step deferred', 'Step put back', 'No steps match', 'Copied'. Make the change line write into it too. Set the copy button's aria-label to 'Copied' for 2s. After defer or put back, move focus to the step's toggle button. Words go in content. This is invisible on the step screens, but it touches the ContentStep and Implementation handlers.
items.bucket_reason: Live-region announcements are a screen-reader refinement with no reported user.

items.title: IMPACT mixes units (steps, people, text labels) and counts the same population three ways
items.fix: cleanupRowWho counts its lists: renames gives 'N policies', overlaps gives 'N policies', namedExclusions gives 'N policies'. Policy rows use cohortWords when pop.guests>0. Add a title/InfoTip to the Impact head from a new content key (pages.plan.columns tip).

items.title: At 5,000 seats the printed plan runs to 354 pages, 262 of them name lists, with the same 2,919 people printed twice
items.fix: For the calendar only, cap any name list in a DESCRIPTION line (the first NAMES_UP_TO, then 'and N more: see the MFA Readiness CSV') with a content key. The prompt pack reads the same artifactLines, so cap there only if the owner agrees.

items.title: 'Align Policy Names' forces the baseline's names, can't be deferred, and sets the plan's finish date

items.title: The 'Differs from the Baseline' block appears on one policy step; other gaps, and the user's own narrowing, show only as small inline grey text or not at all

items.title: Display time zone resets to UTC after reload and changes nothing visible
items.fix: Add one reason line under the select: 'Plan dates and the calendar use this zone; the scan time shows your computer's zone.' (content key). items.title: Home header 'Dark theme' is larger and off-baseline, and the release stage is 'Free public preview' on Home but 'Public beta' on Connect

items.title: Home page and planner feel like two products at the seam

items.title: Instructions name controls the step doesn't have: a Service accounts group picker, a Done shown only inside the open list, and 'Mark as done'

items.title: Connect repeats the full marketing hero and beta notice even after a scan
items.fix: Low value. If wanted, once a scan exists, shrink or collapse the h1 and lede and lift the Plan destination above the flow. That departs from the approved pack, so it needs the owner's yes.

items.title: Capitalisation switches between Title Case, sentence case and mixed forms

The step-heading and lane casing sweep is a content change on finished steps' screens, so it needs the owner's yes, and many tests pin these strings.

items.title: Layout rhythm and control styles vary between surfaces

items.title: Print, 'Download every prompt', 'See the prompts' and the masked bundle freeze the tab for 12–33 s at 5,000 seats, with no busy state

items.title: Steps that correct an existing policy also offer to create a second, baseline-named one, and an existing guest MFA policy is ignored

items.title: The How page has no glossary for the words the plan relies on
